lines.zh: 我踩在空气上，走的像在平地
lines.en: I walk on air as if it were flat ground.

lines.zh: 黑色的披风在我身后翻
lines.en: My black cape turns behind me.

lines.zh: 魔界的风把我的斗篷吹起
lines.en: Demon Realm wind lifts my cloak.
Dust never touches my steps.
I have walked this road too many times.

lines.zh: 我把下巴抬高，扫过前方
lines.en: Chin high, I sweep the road ahead.

lines.zh: 蓄气时脚下的石子在颤
lines.en: When I gather ki the pebbles tremble.

lines.zh: 魔王的手下不需要快步
lines.en: The Demon King's servant need not hurry.

lines.zh: 我从空中斜着落下一段
lines.en: I descend in a slant from the air.

lines.zh: 我走开一条道，草木都避开
lines.en: The plants lean away from my path.
My shadow is longer than I am.

lines.zh: 我抬手拂开挡路的枝杈
lines.en: I brush aside a branch in my path.
I hang in the air without moving.

lines.zh: 魔气从我脚边慢慢散开
lines.en: Demonic aura bleeds slowly from my feet.
The Demon King never strikes first.
This place is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个值得出手的人
lines.en: I wait for someone worth striking.
There is a faint smile at my lip.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可我还是呼吸
lines.en: I need not breathe, yet I breathe.

lines.zh: 空气里有股焦糖的味道
lines.en: The air smells faintly of burnt sugar.

lines.zh: 我在心里数着剩下的时间
lines.en: I count the time left in my head.

lines.zh: 肩上的护甲轻轻响了一下
lines.en: My shoulder guard clicks once.
I gather my cape over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我在看远处的塔，慢慢看
lines.en: I study the far tower, slowly.

lines.zh: 这里的气太薄了，不舒服
lines.en: The ki here is thin; unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我把手心翻上来，试了试风
lines.en: I turn my palm up to test the wind.
I lower my eyes to the top of your head.
You have neither ki nor magic.
A mortal stands before me.
I am amused; genuinely.
You are afraid, but you still stand.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，让你安静
lines.en: I raise a hand to silence you.
There is a strange smell about you.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，像看标本
lines.en: I circle you half way, like a specimen.
Your pulse is racing.
I bow my head and my shadow covers you.
You stand in the road; it is inconvenient.
I recognize the iron in your hand.
I drift down half a foot.
Your heels are sliding backward.

lines.zh: 我一个人站在这儿，你就怕了
lines.en: I stand here alone and you are already afraid.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷往后一掀，露出胸甲
lines.en: I sweep my cape back to show my breastplate.
I wait for you to raise a hand first.
The people of this world are so short.
A slash opens in my cape.

lines.zh: 我后退时脚步乱了半分
lines.en: My steps break half a beat as I retreat.

lines.zh: 这一下打进我的护甲缝
lines.en: That blow found my armor's seam.
I frown, then recover.
A little blood at my lip; I lick it away.
My ki scatters briefly.

lines.zh: 你的拳头有点分量，我记住了
lines.en: Your fist carries some weight; noted
I raise a hand against the next blow.
I withdraw a span and reset my stance.

lines.zh: 斗篷的一角被我撕下来
lines.en: I tear off a corner of my cape.
The Demon Realm has nothing like this.
That smell is mildly interesting.
I stopped needing food long ago.

lines.zh: 可我想知道你拿的是什么
lines.en: But I want to know what you hold.
I extend a hand, fingers down.
Give it to me and I will not kill you.
I have eaten far worse.
This fruit has a good color.
Bring it here; do not make me repeat.

lines.zh: 我把头偏了偏，示意你走近
lines.en: I tilt my head, gesturing you closer.
You hit me and are thrown back.
My body feels like a thin shell.
We meet in the air; I do not move.
I push your shoulder away.

lines.zh: 你的重量对我不算什么
lines.en: Your weight means nothing to me.
My cape is underfoot.

lines.zh: 我侧身让了半寸，纯是戏弄
lines.en: I turn half an inch, purely to toy with you.

lines.zh: 相撞时空气发出一声闷响
lines.en: The air gives a dull boom at the impact.

lines.zh: 我一偏头，你的手擦过披风
lines.en: I tilt my head; your hand grazes my cape.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的膝盖，退了回去
lines.en: You hit my knee and rebound.

lines.zh: 她也是魔界的，我们都懂规矩
lines.en: She is of the Demon Realm too; we know the rules.

lines.zh: 我们不谈感情，只谈立场
lines.en: No feelings; only positions.

lines.zh: 她替我把披风的褶子理顺
lines.en: She smooths the folds of my cape.

lines.zh: 我低头看她，眼神软了一瞬
lines.en: I look down at her and my eyes soften once.
There are no stars in Demon Realm nights.
We hover side by side.
She says I am too arrogant.
I admit it; it is an occupational habit.

lines.zh: 她的手在我腕上停了停
lines.en: Her hand rests a moment on my wrist.
We agree to return to the Demon Realm together.
I bend down slowly.
A crook of my finger and it floats up.
I pick it up and examine it.

lines.zh: 魔界的规矩，谁捡到归谁
lines.en: Demon Realm rule: finders keepers.
I drop the shard into my cape.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片掉落的羽毛
lines.en: I pick up a fallen feather.

lines.zh: 地上这点东西，不够塞牙
lines.en: Not enough here to fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时斗篷铺开一片
lines.en: Bending, my cape spreads out.
I lift it between two fingers.
I toss it to you, then take it back.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，杀气出来了
lines.en: I lift my eyes and the killing intent shows.
My ki presses down all around.
You have been named by me.
I turn and raise my arm.
I have seen this scene many times.
I have already predicted your move.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，然后不动了
lines.en: I smile once, then go still.
The air begins to thicken.

lines.zh: 我伸出一根手指，朝你一点
lines.en: I extend one finger toward you.
I send an afterimage to stand on your left.

lines.zh: 你就算跑，也跑不出这一片
lines.en: Run and you still will not leave this ground.
I count your breaths; they are loud.
Demonic aura spreads from my feet.
I am in no hurry to finish you.

lines.zh: 你的命在我手里，轻得像纸
lines.en: Your life in my hand weighs like paper.
I raise my hand, palm down.
I swap positions with an afterimage.

lines.zh: 你转身时我已经在另一边
lines.en: When you turn, I am on the other side.
I pause a moment behind you.

lines.zh: 你的每一次抬手我都看见
lines.en: I see every lift of your hands.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，人已经撤了
lines.en: An afterimage stays; I have already moved.
The blow you land on nothing is loud.

lines.zh: 我不急，你的气会先耗尽
lines.en: I am patient; your stamina will run out first.
I walk along your flank.

lines.zh: 你找不到我，可我看得见你
lines.en: You cannot find me, but I see you.

lines.zh: 我让残影抬手，你挡错了方向
lines.en: My afterimage raises a hand; you block the wrong way.
Your stamina is falling.
Three steps from you, ready to close.
An afterimage paces behind you.
Your judgment slips for an instant.
I lower my body and bend my knees.

lines.zh: 你的招式我看过一遍了
lines.en: I have seen your technique once already.

lines.zh: 我故意露出破绽，你上当了
lines.en: I show a gap on purpose, and you take it.

lines.zh: 我绕回来，位置又换了一次
lines.en: I circle back and change position again.
The back of my hand cracks your face.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出，气浪把你推远
lines.en: A palm thrust throws you back with a wave.
My kick finds your ribs.
The afterimage moves first; the true body follows.

lines.zh: 你挡住上方，我从下方起手
lines.en: You guard high; I strike from below.
The charge ends and I drive one blow down.
My fist stops at your chest.

lines.zh: 你退了很远，撞断了灌木
lines.en: You fly far and break the brush.
I leave this one so you remember.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩在你身边的土上
lines.en: I stamp the ground beside you.
The hand you block with is shaking.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指尖点向你的额头
lines.en: I raise a hand, fingertip toward your brow.

lines.zh: 我回身一肘，砸在你的背上
lines.en: I spin an elbow into your back.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往下一压
lines.en: I seize your wrist and press it down.

lines.zh: 这一脚把你踢得离了地
lines.en: This kick lifts you off the ground.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我从另一侧切入
lines.en: You block; I cut in from the other side.

lines.zh: 我从魔界的裂缝里出来
lines.en: I come through a rift from the Demon Realm.

lines.zh: 空气先变冷，然后我才出现
lines.en: The air cools first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷落地时没有声音
lines.en: My cape lands without a sound.

lines.zh: 我站定，四周的光暗了一度
lines.en: I stand and the light around dims a shade.

lines.zh: 达普拉，这个名字你该记住
lines.en: Dabura: you should remember that name.
I brush the dust from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看这片天，觉得难看
lines.en: I look at this sky and find it ugly.

lines.zh: 魔界之门在我身后合上
lines.en: The Demon Realm gate closes behind me.

lines.zh: 我来的路上没有遇到像样的人
lines.en: I met no worthy soul on the way.

lines.zh: 我悬起半尺，让脚离开土
lines.en: I rise half a foot off the soil.
A ball of black aura sits in my hand.
The birds far off have all fled.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，地面结了一层霜
lines.en: I lift a foot and frost rimes the ground.

lines.zh: 有谁在远处喊我的名字
lines.en: Someone far off calls my name.
I fasten the clasp of my cape.
The sky is too bright; I narrow my eyes.
I halt at the center of this clearing.
My arrival makes the wind stop.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的斗篷爬上来
lines.en: Fire climbs my cape.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，斗篷翻在头顶
lines.en: I fall, my cape over my head.

lines.zh: 魔气被水压住，我一时动不了
lines.en: Water pins my demonic aura and I cannot move.
The blast knocked me sideways.
An arrow pins into my shoulder guard.

lines.zh: 那股法术缠住我的气，很烦
lines.en: That spell tangles my ki; annoying.

lines.zh: 我本不必进食，可身体在抗议
lines.en: I need no food, yet the body protests.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我的身体，护甲通了电
lines.en: Lightning passes through me and my armor carries the charge.

lines.zh: 虚空在脚下开口，我往下沉
lines.en: The void opens below and I sink.
